ios.desc:
edgi is a learning app that replaces doomscrolling. Put a quick Lesson in front of TikTok, Instagram or any app, play new games every day, and earn a card for every idea you learn. Your cards build a Map of everything you know.

Your attention isn't broken. Your feed is. edgi keeps the habit of scrolling and gives you something to show for it.

FOCUS: AN APP BLOCKER THAT TEACHES YOU SOMETHING
• Put TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn or any app behind a quick Lesson
• Set an intention for each app, like 5 opens a day for 5 minutes each. You decide while you're calm, not while you're reaching for your phone
• Go past it and the next open costs coins, so every extra scroll is a choice
• It doesn't just block you. It sends your attention somewhere better
• Free, with no subscription

LEARN ANYTHING IN 2 MINUTES
• Build your general knowledge with interactive Lessons on psychology, history, science, philosophy, money and more
• Ask Nova anything and get a Lesson made for you
• Explainers to listen to on a walk

PLAY NEW GAMES EVERY DAY
• A daily word game and a daily timeline of history, the same board for everyone
• Games played with the cards you own: build words from their roots, find ideas from different fields that work the same way, answer big questions with what you know
• Every right answer earns XP toward that card

LEARN WITH FRIENDS
• See what your friends are learning, right on your Map
• Send a friend a Lesson and get a high five back
• Tip or gift coins with a note, and see who looked at your Map

COLLECT WHAT YOU LEARN
• Earn a card for every idea you learn, then make it Foil and Gold
• Complete Sets and earn rewards
• Keep your streak safe as it changes with the seasons
• Watch every card join a Map of everything you know, connected idea to idea

Learn something interesting. Follow the rabbit hole. Close some tabs.

edgi is free to start, Focus included. edgi Pro adds the Pro games and past daily boards, higher creation limits, offline Lessons, everyone who looked at your Map, and more.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Edgi – Letterboxd or Strava for your brain

quotes.text:
Hi HN

Excited to share edgi.tv - an educational media platform where the things you learn accumulate into a visual map of your intellectual interests. The experiment is whether you can build a consumer product around intellectual identity, something like Letterboxd or Strava but for your brain.

The main entry point is a curated TikTok-style feed that surfaces vids from creators like Kurzgezagt, VSauce, AstroAlexandra, Cleo Abram, 3Blue1Brown, etymologynerd, etc with interactive games accessible on top of the videos. You can also create podcasts, quizzes, etc with AI on any topic you’re interested in and earn XP towards concepts.

Concepts are the unit that connect all media together and create the knowledge graph and power the rec algo. As you engage with a concept, you have a chance to earn a Concept Card (a Pokemon-style collectible for that idea). The concepts then accumulate on a mind map, which doubles as a social surface so you can see what friends are interested in and where your interests overlap.

I’m an adjunct at NYU and have taught there for ~7 years. I started when I was 23. In college I worked on a project where we redesigned the architecture and curriculum of a high school from scratch, and since then I’ve been kind of obsessed with problems in education and  what the future of learning looks like.
